categories.main_business_segments: Liaoning He Eye Hospital Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in specialized ophthalmic medical services and optometry services. Its main business includes diagnosis and treatment of common and complex eye diseases such as cataracts, glaucoma, vitreoretinal diseases, refractive errors, and pediatric eye diseases. The company also provides vision correction surgeries, optical correction, and vision training services. Additionally, it engages in innovative medical technologies including gene detection and stem cell therapies, and operates an internet-based medical health platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced medical technologies such as AI-assisted diagnostics, big data analytics, gene detection, stem cell clinical applications, and digital ophthalmic equipment. It employs a three-tier eye health medical service model integrating primary, secondary, and tertiary care with digital and AI-enabled screening and treatment. Key technologies include AI-powered retinal imaging, personalized refractive surgery using AI and femtosecond laser systems, and gene panel testing for hereditary eye diseases. The company also develops proprietary software for retinal vessel analysis and integrates cloud-based medical data platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are patients with eye diseases across all age groups, including children, adults, and the elderly, requiring ophthalmic diagnosis, treatment, and vision correction. The company serves both public and private healthcare markets, focusing on comprehensive eye health management and vision care. It also targets optometry service consumers and partners with medical insurance systems. Geographically, the main market is China, with a strong presence in Liaoning province and expanding into Beijing, Chongqing, Chengdu, Hainan, Guangzhou, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, with 127 eye care institutions across Liaoning, Beijing, Chongqing, Chengdu, Hainan, and Guangzhou. It has subsidiaries and branches in major cities including Shenyang, Dalian, Shanghai, and others. The company also engages in international cooperation and training programs, supporting developing countries in Asia, Africa, and Latin America. Its overseas operations include subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Liaoning He Eye Hospital Group operates primarily in the downstream segment of the healthcare supply chain, providing specialized ophthalmic medical services and vision care directly to patients. It also manages procurement of medical supplies, pharmaceuticals, and optical materials through centralized group purchasing to ensure quality and cost efficiency. The company invests in upstream innovation through research and development in gene therapy and medical devices but mainly functions as a healthcare service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on building a digital, AI-enabled, full lifecycle eye health management system called 'Smart Bright City.' It emphasizes integration of AI, big data, gene technology, and regenerative medicine to enhance precision medicine and personalized care. R&D priorities include AI-assisted glaucoma screening, diabetic retinopathy management, myopia control, dry eye treatment, and development of intelligent ophthalmic devices. The company also invests in expanding its internet hospital platform and nationwide optometry franchise network.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct medical service fees including outpatient consultations, surgeries, inpatient treatments, and vision correction services. The company also earns income from optometry services, sale of optical products, and medical consumables. Additional revenue streams include internet-based medical consultations, pharmaceutical sales, and leasing or training services. The company’s revenue is largely fee-for-service with some income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the ophthalmic healthcare sector dominated by both public and private specialized eye hospitals. It holds a leading position in Liaoning province and is expanding into major metropolitan areas. Competitors include other private ophthalmic hospitals and clinics, as well as public eye care institutions. The company differentiates itself through its integrated three-tier service model, advanced technology adoption, comprehensive lifecycle management, and strong brand reputation supported by academic and international collaborations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.096 billion, a 7.56% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.4 million. The decline was mainly due to intensified industry competition and reforms in medical insurance payment methods. The company has substantial total assets of over RMB 2.2 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.88 billion. Despite short-term profit pressure, the company continues to invest heavily in innovation, digital transformation, and expansion, aiming for sustainable long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes personalized, technology-driven eye health management across the full lifecycle, integrating AI, gene testing, and regenerative medicine to provide precise and innovative treatments. Its three-tier eye health service model ensures accessible, high-quality care with efficient resource allocation and patient-centered services. Differentiation also comes from its strong academic research, international cooperation, and comprehensive digital platforms that enhance patient experience and clinical outcomes. The company’s commitment to innovation and quality positions it as a trusted leader in China’s ophthalmic healthcare market.
